newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Autopsy appears to clear S.Korean students.
newsitem.headline: Autopsy appears to clear S.Korean students.

text.p: An autopsy on a South Korean policeman who died during a campus clash appeared to rule out the possibility he was beaten to death by students, a police official said on Tuesday.

The autopsy suggested the officer's injuries were consistent with being run over by a vehicle, according to the official, who said he had read the autopsy report. Students maintain the 21-year-old victim was knocked down by a police teargas launcher.
Earlier, state radio reported that President Kim Young-sam had demanded a thorough investigation into the death and "severe punishment" for those responsible, depending on the results of the autopsy.
State prosecutors on Monday called for the arrest of "criminals" behind the death of Yoo Ji-woong.
Media reports had accused students of beating the officer to death. The officer died in hospital on Monday after being taken from the scene of fierce hand-to-hand fighting outside Hanyang University.
Television footage showed students lashing out with iron bars at several officers as they lay helpless on the street.
